policy.description: Shared infrastructure is allowed when the endpoint is specific enough to the game/service or supported by concrete operational evidence. Bare provider roots and overly broad cloud CIDRs remain excluded.

entries.note: User reports these Riot/Vanguard hostnames in a working exclude configuration. Shared provider IPs from the same comment are not automatically promoted because they are non-exclusive/ephemeral.
Dedicated VRChat list used as a configured source; only specific shared hostnames are promoted, not provider-wide roots or broad /16 IP ranges.
Community Roblox routing/blocking discussion and Roblox CSP corroborate several third-party endpoints.
Provider-hosted endpoints whose hostname itself contains an unambiguous game/vendor identifier are retained after semantic review. Generic provider roots remain excluded.
